title: Derived-support spectral sequence for a sum of ideals
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], let $I,J$ be finitely generated ideals, and let $M$ be any $A$-module. Write $H_K^n(N)=R^n\Gamma_K(N)$ for the right derived functors of the ideal-power torsion functor [def-sbc-ideal-power-torsion-functor], for $K=I,J,I+J$. There is a natural convergent first-quadrant spectral sequence $E_2^{p,q}=H_I^p(H_J^q(M))\Longrightarrow H_{I+J}^{p+q}(M)$, where $p,q\geq0$. Convergence means that for each $n\geq0$, $H_{I+J}^n(M)$ has a finite filtration whose associated graded modules are $E_\infty^{p,n-p}$ for $0\leq p\leq n$.
